properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js is elliptic's hash layer — the code that produces every secp256k1 signature digest in this project's ethers stack. Present in the shipped tree even though application code never calls it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the system's ONLY signature curve: transaction signing by ethers signers, claim signatures verified on-chain via Identity.getRecoveredAddress → ecrecover (contracts/Identity.sol:572). Shor-vulnerable; migration is an Ethereum-protocol-level concern (BLS-12-371/EVM PQ work), not changeable in this repo alone.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: single-round MD5 KDF shipped inside the Hardhat toolchain's browserified crypto polyfill; reachable only through tooling code paths, never by the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ERC-734 key management CLI tasks for the OnchainID identity contract. The "(ECDSA = 1)" label documents ERC-734 key type 1; the tasks perform real secp256k1 ECDSA transaction signing and on-chain key registration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: available in the shipped node_modules; no call site found in the application (contracts, tasks, tests). tweetnacl also supplies the X25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305 entries in this inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: same tweetnacl@1.0.3 package as the Ed25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305 entries; available in the shipped tree, no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (pre-FIPS-202, the Ethereum-standardized variant) is the hashing backbone of the whole OnchainID protocol: ERC-734 key hashes, ERC-735 claim IDs, and EIP-191 signed-message digests. Quantum-safe in practice (256-bit preimage resistance, Grover square-root); only a digest-size policy item. Changeable here only at protocol level — Ethereum fixes Keccak-256.
